cyclotomic.scope: integer weights in receipts; symbolic distribution valid for Re(s)>1; 264 branches differ from 240 primitive field conjugates

combined_model.name: root-permutation-plus-Cartan spectral model
combined_model.scope: verified cyclic direct sum; adjoint-lift identification is not claimed
combined_model.zero_proof: product of the three positive strictly increasing factors is strictly increasing; its value at s=2 is 1*2*4=8

cyclotomic_bridge.limitation: 240 field conjugates are not thereby E8 roots; no categorical colimit is established
cyclotomic_bridge.restriction_to_order_30: 48 copies of the 8-dimensional rational Coxeter module

e8.verified_by: integer and rational Python computation; not Lean

independent_numeric_diagnostics.arithmetic: Decimal precision 200; Euler-transformed eta with 320 terms; finite pi literal
independent_numeric_diagnostics.limitation: rounded zeta and pi values are comparisons only; analytic validity comes from the cited theorem and exact algebraic cancellation
independent_numeric_diagnostics.provenance: recomputed here independently of harmonic recurrence and Fourier-zeta coefficient construction; no scratch input

limitations: This does not prove the supplied artifacts categorical colimit or arbitrary E8 unification claims.
The 240 Galois conjugates are not identified with the 240 E8 roots by matching cardinalities.
The E8 root-permutation-plus-Cartan model is a verified cyclic direct sum; no adjoint lift with root-space signs is asserted.
The two-order family is complete only within the cited polynomial ansatz; identities need not be numerically linearly independent.
Numerical Decimal comparisons are diagnostics and have no rigorous zeta enclosure.
proof_scope: exact finite integer/rational calculations and cited analytic theorems; not Lean-kernel proofs of the new analytic identities
